I added a small "PARTNEŘI AKCE" line just above the green bottom bar on the Instagram event post (artboard `ig-event-square`), but I couldn't confirm how it looks. Every screenshot came out as a tiny thumbnail, so I couldn't see the new line or whether it fits.

**What's on the line:** the label "PARTNEŘI AKCE" in small yellow capitals, in the same style as the "KDY" and "KDE" labels on the post, followed by a thin light rule to the right edge. It sits 18 px above the yellow edge on top of the bottom bar.

**What to check by eye:** I couldn't measure where the text block above it ends. My estimate puts it only a few pixels above the new line. If they look cramped, moving the text block up about 20 px fixes it (its top is at 766 px now).

**What I left out:** partner logos. The canvas only has the club partner list, which the results card labels "PARTNEŘI KLUBU". I didn't want to show them as event partners without knowing they are, so the line is just the label for now. If those 15 partners are right for the event, I can add a row of their small logos after the label.

The canvas check reports one error, but it was there before my edit: one artboard in the disciplines carousel has its ID written as an expression instead of plain text (around line 1273). The check also flags the colour I gave the rule because it's written as a raw value rather than a design-system colour, but that's only a warning. Nothing else on the canvas changed.
